The workshop

A proper independent garage. The proprietor learned his trade inside SAAB's dealer network in the 1970s, then set up on his own. One workshop. Fifty years. The same standards.

No call centre and no chain. The person who books your car is the person who knows its history, and puts their own name to the job.

Customers travel from Kent, West Sussex and London, and most have been coming back for years. Some for over two decades.

The specialism

The South Coast's SAAB people.

Bourne Motors has specialised in SAAB since 1992. When the dealer network closed, the knowledge stayed here. The 900, the 9-3, the 9-5, we know them, and we hold the diagnostic kit and the parts channels to keep them running.

Drive something more ordinary? Just as welcome. The same discipline goes into every Ford, VW, BMW and Toyota that comes through the door.
